title: Column Desk Inspect
summary: Inspect CSV structure on your device before a database or CRM import.
description: Open a UTF-8 CSV to spot blank or duplicate headers and inconsistent row widths. Preview the columns and export a structural report as JSON. Supports quoted commas and multiline fields.
productTranscript: A vendor CSV opens in Chromium. Column Desk shows the inconsistent fourth record and exports the same finding to a JSON report.
setupTranscript: The recording shows the checksum, a fresh extraction, successful offline npm install and local server, then uploads a CSV and finds the broken row.
setup: Extract the ZIP. With Node.js 24 or newer, run npm ci --offline and npm start. Open http://127.0.0.1:4173 and choose a UTF-8 CSV.
costs: No API keys, paid services or hosting are needed to run the local workflow.
notices: Original code. MIT license. No third-party runtime dependencies.
support: For a setup issue, include your browser version and Node version. Keep the CSV private.

title: Acorn Trail
summary: Collect three acorns and reach camp in a pixel art browser game that runs offline.
description: A short woodland adventure with original pixel art, keyboard controls and a complete playable loop. The public sample includes the entire Node.js server, browser game and artwork code.
productTranscript: The title screen opens under a full moon. Press Enter to begin, hold the right arrow, collect all three acorns and reach camp. The status confirms Trail complete.
setupTranscript: The clean-install recording shows the exact archive checksum, extraction, the successful offline npm install and the local server address. The downloaded game opens in Chrome and completes the trail.
setup: Extract the ZIP into a fresh folder. Run npm ci --offline, then npm start with Node.js 24 or newer. Open http://127.0.0.1:4173 and press Enter.
costs: The core workflow requires no API keys, paid subscriptions or hosting. The isolated runner verified the documented desktop path.
notices: Original game art and code. No third-party runtime dependencies or assets.
support: For a problem running the sample, include your Node and browser versions in a support case.
